cartes.q: Tourism creates jobs. {{However::cependant}}, it also damages the environment.
cartes.r: However se place en tête de phrase, suivi d'une virgule.

cartes.q: {{Although/Even though::bien que}} tourism creates jobs, it damages the environment.
cartes.r: Although + sujet + verbe, sans subjonctif en anglais.

cartes.q: Some cities welcome tourists, {{whereas/while::alors que}} others try to keep them away.
cartes.r: Whereas exprime une opposition entre deux faits.

cartes.q: Protests can raise awareness. {{Moreover/Furthermore/What is more::de plus}}, they can lead to real change.
cartes.r: Connecteurs d'addition : moreover, furthermore, what is more, in addition.

cartes.q: Short-term rentals have multiplied. {{As a result/Consequently::par conséquent}}, rents have soared.
cartes.r: As a result, consequently, therefore : conséquence.

cartes.q: {{Despite/In spite of::malgré}} the rain, thousands of people marched.
cartes.r: Despite + nom (jamais despite of) ; in spite of + nom.

cartes.q: {{On the one hand::d'une part}}, tourism boosts the economy; {{on the other hand::d'autre part}}, it harms local communities.
cartes.r: Structure classique pour présenter deux points de vue dans un essai.

cartes.q: {{In order to/So as to::afin de}} curb overtourism, the city introduced visitor caps.
cartes.r: In order to / so as to + base verbale : but.

cartes.q: {{Unless::à moins que}} the government backs down, the strike will go on.
cartes.r: Unless = if… not. Présent après unless, même pour parler du futur.

cartes.q: {{Not only::non seulement}} does tourism create jobs, {{but it also::mais il … aussi}} brings in foreign currency.
cartes.r: Not only en tête de phrase entraîne l'inversion : does tourism create.

cartes.q: {{Owing to/Due to/Because of::en raison de}} the strike, all flights were cancelled.
cartes.r: Owing to / due to / because of + nom : cause.

cartes.q: {{The more::plus}} tourists come, {{the more::plus}} prices rise.
cartes.r: The more…, the more… : plus…, plus…

cartes.q: {{To sum up/In conclusion/All in all::pour conclure}}, sustainable tourism seems to be the only way forward.
cartes.r: Pour introduire la conclusion d'un essai.

cartes.q: {{It is often argued::on affirme souvent}} that protests are useless, {{yet::pourtant}} history proves otherwise.
cartes.r: Yet = pourtant, mais. It is often argued that… introduit une thèse à discuter.

cartes.q: {{As far as::en ce qui concerne}} tourism {{is concerned::…}}, the figures speak for themselves.
cartes.r: As far as X is concerned = en ce qui concerne X.
